description: Frontend pharmacy context, switcher component, and owner management pages. Creates PharmacyContext for managing selected pharmacy state, PharmacySwitcher dropdown for system owners to switch between locations, OwnerDashboard with consolidated metrics and pharmacy comparison, PharmacyManagement page for CRUD operations on pharmacies, and StaffManagement page for managing users across locations. Integrates with existing UI component library (Modal, Field, Badge, PageHead from ui.jsx).
steps: Create web/src/contexts/PharmacyContext.jsx: Import createContext, useContext, useState, useCallback, useEffect from react. Import get from ../api.js. Create PharmacyContext with createContext(null). Export PharmacyProvider component accepting {children, user} props. Inside: useState for selectedPharmacyId (default null = all pharmacies), pharmacyList (array). Compute isSystemOwner = user?.is_system_owner || false. useEffect on isSystemOwner: if true, fetch get('/owner/pharmacies').then(data => setPharmacyList(data.pharmacies || [])). Define switchPharmacy = useCallback((id) => { setSelectedPharmacyId(id); }, []). Return <PharmacyContext.Provider value={{ selectedPharmacyId, pharmacyList, switchPharmacy, isSystemOwner }}>{children}</PharmacyContext.Provider>. Export usePharmacy = () => useContext(PharmacyContext).

Create web/src/components/PharmacySwitcher.jsx: Import usePharmacy from ../contexts/PharmacyContext. Export default function PharmacySwitcher(). const { selectedPharmacyId, pharmacyList, switchPharmacy, isSystemOwner } = usePharmacy(). If !isSystemOwner, return null. Return <select value={selectedPharmacyId || ''} onChange={(e) => switchPharmacy(e.target.value ? parseInt(e.target.value) : null)}><option value=''>All Pharmacies</option>{pharmacyList.map(p => <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>{p.name}</option>)}</select>. Style with existing form styles (class='field' pattern from ui.jsx).

Create web/src/pages/OwnerDashboard.jsx: Import useLoad, PageHead, Badge, Spinner, ErrorBox from ../ui.jsx. Import get from ../api.js. Import KES, num from ../util.js. Import usePharmacy from ../contexts/PharmacyContext. Export default function OwnerDashboard(). const { selectedPharmacyId } = usePharmacy(). const { loading, data, error, reload } = useLoad(() => get('/owner/dashboard'), []). If loading, return <Spinner />. If error, return <ErrorBox error={error} retry={reload} />. Render <PageHead title='Owner Dashboard' icon='🏢' sub='Consolidated view across all your pharmacy locations' />. Display summary cards grid: div.summary-cards with 4 cards (Total Pharmacies, Combined Sales Today, Total Inventory Value, Total Customers). Use data.total_pharmacies, data.total_sales, data.total_inventory_value, data.total_customers. Use KES() for money formatting.

In OwnerDashboard.jsx, add pharmacy comparison table: {data.pharmacies.map(p => )}
PharmacyToday's SalesInventory ValueLow StockExpiry AlertsStatus
{p.name}{KES(p.sales_today)}{KES(p.inventory_value)}{p.low_stock_count} 10 ? 'danger' : p.expiry_alerts > 0 ? 'warning' : 'ok'}>{p.expiry_alerts}{p.active ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'}
. Add quick actions section with buttons: 'Add Pharmacy' (navigate to /owner/pharmacies), 'Manage Staff' (navigate to /owner/staff), 'View Reports' (navigate to /owner/reports).

Create web/src/pages/PharmacyManagement.jsx: Import useState from react. Import useLoad, Modal, Field, PageHead, Badge, useToast from ../ui.jsx. Import get, post, put from ../api.js. Export default function PharmacyManagement(). const toast = useToast(). const { loading, data, error, reload } = useLoad(() => get('/owner/pharmacies'), []). useState for modal open/closed, editingPharmacy. Render <PageHead title='My Pharmacies' icon='🏪'><button onClick={() => setModal({open: true, pharmacy: null})}>+ Add Pharmacy</button></PageHead>. Display pharmacy list as cards or table: name, address, phone, email, status badge (active/inactive), actions (Edit, View Stats, Toggle Active). Implement Add/Edit modal with Form fields: name, address, phone, email, kra_pin, licence_no, superintendent_name, superintendent_reg_no. On submit: if editing, await put('/owner/pharmacies/' + id, formData); else await post('/owner/pharmacies', formData). toast('Pharmacy saved'); reload(); close modal.

Create web/src/pages/StaffManagement.jsx: Import useState from react. Import useLoad, Modal, Field, PageHead, Badge, useToast from ../ui.jsx. Import get, post, put from ../api.js. Import ROLE_LABEL from ../util.js. Import usePharmacy from ../contexts/PharmacyContext. Export default function StaffManagement(). const toast = useToast(). const { pharmacyList } = usePharmacy(). const [filterPharmacy, setFilterPharmacy] = useState(null). const [search, setSearch] = useState(''). const { loading, data, error, reload } = useLoad(() => get('/owner/staff'), []). Filter staff list by search and filterPharmacy. Render <PageHead title='All Staff' icon='👥'><button onClick={() => setModal({open: true, user: null})}>+ Add Staff</button></PageHead>. Add filter bar: <select onChange={e => setFilterPharmacy(e.target.value)}><option value=''>All Pharmacies</option>{pharmacyList.map...}</select> and <input placeholder='Search by name or email' onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)} />.

In StaffManagement.jsx, display staff table: {filteredStaff.map(u => )}

{u.name}{u.email}{u.phone}{ROLE_LABEL[u.role]}{u.pharmacy_name || 'Unassigned'}{u.active ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'}
. Implement Add/Edit user modal with fields: name, email, phone, role (dropdown), password (only for new users). On submit: await post('/owner/staff', formData); toast('User created'); reload().

In StaffManagement.jsx, implement Assign to Pharmacy modal: triggered by Assign button. Show dropdown to select pharmacy from pharmacyList, role dropdown (owner/pharmacist/cashier/stock_clerk), checkbox 'Can manage staff'. On submit: await post('/owner/staff/' + userId + '/assign', {pharmacy_id, role, can_manage_staff}); toast('Staff assigned'); reload(). Implement Unassign action: await delete from '/owner/staff/' + userId + '/unassign?pharmacy_id=' + pharmacyId; toast('Assignment removed'); reload().

Update web/src/App.jsx: Import PharmacyProvider from './contexts/PharmacyContext.jsx'. Import PharmacySwitcher from './components/PharmacySwitcher.jsx'. Import OwnerDashboard from './pages/OwnerDashboard.jsx', PharmacyManagement from './pages/PharmacyManagement.jsx', StaffManagement from './pages/StaffManagement.jsx'. In Shell component, wrap content in <PharmacyProvider user={user}>...</PharmacyProvider>. In NAV array, add items: { id: 'owner-dashboard', label: 'Owner Dashboard', icon: '🏢', roles: ['owner'], requiresSystemOwner: true, C: OwnerDashboard }, { id: 'owner-pharmacies', label: 'My Pharmacies', icon: '🏪', roles: ['owner'], requiresSystemOwner: true, C: PharmacyManagement }, { id: 'owner-staff', label: 'All Staff', icon: '👥', roles: ['owner'], requiresSystemOwner: true, C: StaffManagement }.

In App.jsx Shell component, update NAV filtering: const items = NAV.filter(n => n.roles.includes(user.role) && (!n.requiresSystemOwner || user.is_system_owner)). Update default route logic in fromHash(): if no hash and user.is_system_owner, return 'owner-dashboard'; else return 'dashboard'. In sidebar rendering, after brand section, add {user.is_system_owner &&
}. In mobile-bar, show current pharmacy name if selected (from context).

Test frontend: npm run build:web builds without errors. Start npm run dev:web, open http://localhost:5173. Login as system owner (requires backend FEAT-001/002 complete), verify Owner Dashboard appears in nav, click it, verify summary cards and pharmacy table display. Navigate to My Pharmacies, test Add Pharmacy form, verify new pharmacy appears. Navigate to All Staff, test Add Staff and Assign to Pharmacy modals. Verify PharmacySwitcher dropdown appears in header with All Pharmacies + individual locations. Test switching context updates URLs with ?pharmacy_id= param.
acceptance_criteria: PharmacyContext provides selectedPharmacyId, pharmacyList, switchPharmacy, and isSystemOwner to all components
PharmacySwitcher dropdown appears only for system owners, shows All Pharmacies + list of owned pharmacies
OwnerDashboard displays consolidated metrics and pharmacy comparison table with color-coded badges
PharmacyManagement page supports CRUD operations on pharmacies with modal forms
StaffManagement page displays staff table with filtering, supports Add/Edit user, Assign/Unassign to pharmacy
App.jsx navigation shows owner menu items only for system owners, defaults to owner-dashboard for system owners
All pages use existing UI components (Modal, Field, Badge, PageHead) and follow established styling patterns
Frontend build completes without errors and pages render correctly in browser
verification: npm run build:web completes successfully with no errors
npm run dev:web starts Vite dev server, http://localhost:5173 loads
Login as system owner (created via backend), verify owner navigation items appear
Navigate to Owner Dashboard, verify summary cards show total_pharmacies, total_sales, etc.
Verify pharmacy comparison table displays with Name, Today's Sales, Inventory Value, Alerts columns
Navigate to My Pharmacies, click Add Pharmacy, fill form, submit, verify new pharmacy appears in list
Navigate to All Staff, click Add Staff, create user, verify appears in table
Click Assign button on user, select pharmacy and role, submit, verify user.pharmacy_name updates
Verify PharmacySwitcher dropdown in header shows 'All Pharmacies' as default option
Select pharmacy from switcher, verify URL updates with ?pharmacy_id= param (if integrated with API calls)
Test filtering staff by pharmacy and search by name
Login as regular (non-system-owner) user, verify owner menu items do NOT appear
